response.justification: Szabo brings valuable geospatial expertise through GISCollective and proven ability to optimize distributed systems handling massive scale. However, his C++ experience is over a decade old, with his career trajectory firmly toward TypeScript/Node.js full-stack development rather than systems programming. More critically, he lacks domain expertise in routing systems or navigation—his GIS background is data-collection focused, not routing-tile optimization. While his demonstrated willingness to expand expertise and strong engineering discipline are positive signals, the gap between his current skills (web/TypeScript) and the role's core requirements (modern C++/Rust, routing systems domain knowledge) presents substantial risk.
strengths: Deep geospatial expertise through GISCollective platform and multiple GIS applications; understands data pipelines and geo-data architecture relevant to mapping systems
Proven ability to optimize high-performance distributed systems at scale (millions of requests/second at Dunnhumby) using async I/O, caching, and low-latency design patterns
Strong software engineering discipline emphasizing testing, craftsmanship, and architectural thinking; demonstrates genuine willingness to learn across diverse technical domains
concerns: C++ experience is over 10 years outdated (last significant work in 2015); recent career focused on TypeScript/JavaScript/Node.js, not systems-level programming or performance-critical work
No exposure to navigation systems, routing algorithms, or routing-tile optimization despite geospatial background; GIS experience centers on data collection rather than routing pipeline work

Career trajectory away from systems programming toward application/product development; no demonstrated experience with data pipeline optimization, real-time traffic integration, or similar domain requirements
